_description: Season 1 upload schedule — interleaved (story EP + standalone EP alternating)

strategy_notes.interleave_reason: Two entry points: EP01 (story arc start) and EP05 (standalone). New viewers can enter from either.
strategy_notes.shorts_independence: Shorts run on Mon/Wed/Fri regardless of longform schedule. Mix of episode clips + independent tips.
strategy_notes.cold_start_mitigation: First 4 weeks: push EP01+EP05 Shorts aggressively. Both are entry points.
strategy_notes.community_response: Reply to first 10 comments within 2 hours of upload.
strategy_notes.end_screen: Always show EP05 (standalone entry) + latest episode.
